svg.title: Inspect only when needed
svg.desc: The inspector is a token-protected IPv4-loopback dashboard for queue/ownership metadata, on-demand screenshots and human takeover. Its URL grants access to the profile inspector; keep it private. Optional live preview captures at one frame per second while enabled and visible; capture is off by default. record explicitly writes a PNG sequence and JSON manifest, bounded by duration (1–600 seconds), rate (0.1–5 fps), 600 frames and a 64 MiB maximum byte budget. Captures can contain signed-in page content. There is no video encoder or always-on recording service.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
